Anne Sturges Bourne\'s farm bailiff

He married (1852) Miss Sturges Bourne\'s former ladies\' maid [Ellen Brown](/person/1820) (b.

Cranbrook, Kent 1825/6), who died in 1860 leaving several young children. [1861 census; marriage and death register]
